verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, not a service that holds user data, so exporting data in open formats and leaving is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product offers data export or account portability; Ryzen Master tuning profiles are local configuration, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
